svg.text: 3D CAD Model 6 (Long-Range 80/20 Sweet Spot): True Kit Navigator 300 (65–79 nm)

5.38 kWh dry LiFePO4 + 5.38 kWh pod = 10.8 kWh!

Cuts induced drag ~30% + keeps Split STOL control!
Internal STOL & rudder servos — 0 deck boxes!
60×9 mm • Zero pod cut-out, 5.5" sand clearance
